<Tag slot="tag">

<TagTitle slot="title">

# Beta Rag Managed Indexes Endpoints

</TagTitle>

<TagDescription slot="description">

(beta) RAG API - managed indexes.

</TagDescription>

</Tag>

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes \{#operation-list_indexes_v1_rag_managed_indexes_get\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_List managed indexes_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Lists all managed search indexes for the current workspace.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-list_indexes_v1_rag_managed_indexes_get_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-list_indexes_v1_rag_managed_indexes_get_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes \
 -X GET \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-list_indexes_v1_rag_managed_indexes_get_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-list_indexes_v1_rag_managed_indexes_get_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.list({});

  for await (const page of result) {
    console.log(page);
  }
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

</CodeSampleTabbedSection>

</OperationCodeSamplesSection>

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes \{#operation-create_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_post\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Create a managed index_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Reserves a managed search index and starts asynchronous backing-table provisioning. Poll the returned Location until status is ready or failed.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-create_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_post_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-create_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_post_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes \
 -X POST \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
  "config": {
    "embedding": {
      "dimensions": 87,
      "name": "My resource"
    }
  },
  "name": "My resource"
}'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-create_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_post_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-create_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_post_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.create({
    name: "<value>",
    config: {
      embedding: {
        type: "custom",
        name: "<value>",
        dimensions: 543021,
      },
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

</CodeSampleTabbedSection>

</OperationCodeSamplesSection>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\} \{#operation-get_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_get\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Get a managed index_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Returns the managed search index with the given name.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name} \
 -X GET \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE'
```

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-get_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_get_code-samples_typescript"

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-get_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_get_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.get({
    indexName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>PUT</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\} \{#operation-update_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_put\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Update a managed index schema_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Records a new schema for the managed search index and applies it asynchronously. The index keeps serving its current schema until the new one is on disk; poll it until status is ready. Additive only: the new schema must keep every field the current one has.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

```curl
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{

}'
```

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-update_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_put_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.update({
    indexName: "<value>",
    updateManagedIndexRequest: {
      schema: {},
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>DELETE</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\} \{#operation-delete_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_delete\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Delete a managed index_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Marks the managed search index for deletion and returns it with status deleting. The backing table is dropped asynchronously; poll the index until it returns 404.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-delete_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_delete_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-delete_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_delete_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name} \
 -X DELETE \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-delete_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_delete_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-delete_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_delete_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.delete({
    indexName: "<value>",
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

</CodeSampleTabbedSection>

</OperationCodeSamplesSection>

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/documents \{#operation-ingest_documents_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_documents_post\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Ingest documents into a managed index_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Validates and persists documents. Always returns 200; each document is reported as accepted or rejected in the response body.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-ingest_documents_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_documents_post_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-ingest_documents_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_documents_post_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name}/documents \
 -X POST \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
```

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>DELETE</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/documents \{#operation-delete_documents_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_documents_delete\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Delete documents from a managed index_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Deletes the given documents by id. Returns the ids actually removed and, in `missing`, any requested ids that were not present.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

  slot="tab"

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name}/documents \
 -X DELETE \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
  "document_ids": [
    "ipsum eiusmod"
  ]
}'
```

```typescript
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.deleteDocuments({
    indexName: "<value>",
    deleteDocumentsRequest: {
      documentIds: [],
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/search \{#operation-search_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_search_post\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Search a managed index_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Runs an approximate-nearest-neighbor vector search over the index and returns matching chunks, closest-first.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-search_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_search_post_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-search_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_search_post_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name}/search \
 -X POST \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
  "retriever": {
    "query": "ipsum eiusmod"
  }
}'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-search_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_search_post_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-search_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_search_post_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.search({
    indexName: "<value>",
    searchRequest: {
      retriever: {
        topK: 20,
        type: "nearest_neighbour",
      },
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

</CodeSampleTabbedSection>

</OperationCodeSamplesSection>

<Operation>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/navigate \{#operation-navigate_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_navigate_post\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Navigate to adjacent chunks_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Returns the chunks adjacent to a position within a source, in reading order. NEXT fetches chunks at or after the end offset; PREVIOUS fetches chunks before the start offset. A 200 with an empty list means the source exists but no chunk falls in the requested direction; a 404 means the source has no chunks at all.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-navigate_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_navigate_post_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

cURL

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-navigate_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_navigate_post_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name}/navigate \
 -X POST \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
  "direction": "next",
  "end_offset": 87,
  "source_id": "ipsum eiusmod",
  "start_offset": 14
}'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-navigate_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_navigate_post_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

TypeScript

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-navigate_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_navigate_post_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

async function run() {
  const result = await mistral.beta.rag.managedIndexes.navigate({
    indexName: "<value>",
    navigateRequest: {
      sourceId: "<id>",
      startOffset: 506558,
      endOffset: 410700,
      direction: "previous",
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

</CodeSampleTabbedSection>

</OperationCodeSamplesSection>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/read \{#operation-read_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_read_post\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Read chunks within a span_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Returns the chunks of a source whose span falls within [start_offset, end_offset). Either bound may be omitted to leave that side open. A 200 with an empty list means the source exists but no chunk falls in the range; a 404 means the source has no chunks at all.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationTitleSection slot="title">

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>POST</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/grep \{#operation-grep_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_grep_post\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Grep for a pattern within a source_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Lexical substring match within a single source, in reading order. PHRASE mode matches the pattern literally (whitespace-sensitive, case-insensitive); TERM mode requires every whitespace-split token present in any order. A 200 with an empty list means the source exists but no chunk matched; a 404 means the source has no chunks at all.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

<OperationCodeSamplesSection slot="code-samples">

<CodeSampleTabbedSection>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-grep_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_grep_post_code-samples_curl"
  tags={{"codeSample":"curl"}}
>

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-grep_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_grep_post_code-samples_curl"
>

<CodeSample>

```curl
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/rag/managed_indexes/{index_name}/grep \
 -X POST \
 -H 'Authorization: Bearer YOUR_APIKEY_HERE' \
 -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
 -d '{
  "pattern": "ipsum eiusmod",
  "source_id": "consequat do"
}'
```

</CodeSample>

</SectionContent>

<CodeSampleTab
  slot="tab"
  id="operation-grep_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_grep_post_code-samples_typescript"
  tags={{"codeSample":"typescript"}}
>

</CodeSampleTab>

<SectionContent
  slot="content"
  id="operation-grep_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_grep_post_code-samples_typescript"
>

<CodeSample>

```typescript
import { Mistral } from "@mistralai/mistralai";

const mistral = new Mistral({
  apiKey: process.env["MISTRAL_API_KEY"] ?? "",
});

    indexName: "<value>",
    grepRequest: {
      sourceId: "<id>",
      pattern: "<value>",
    },
  });

  console.log(result);
}

run();
```

## <Pill variant="primary"><b>GET</b></Pill> /v1/rag/managed\_indexes/\{index\_name\}/chunks/\{chunk\_id\} \{#operation-get_chunk_index_v1_rag_managed_indexes_index_name_chunks_chunk_id_get\}

</OperationTitleSection>

<OperationSummarySection slot="summary">

_Get a single chunk by id_

</OperationSummarySection>

<OperationDescriptionSection slot="description">

Returns a single chunk by its canonical id. A 404 means no chunk with that id exists in the index.

</OperationDescriptionSection>

```typescript
}
```
